lessons.title: Use SLSQP with proper constraints
lessons.summary: Optimization with SLSQP and equality constraints ensures the integral constraint is satisfied.
lessons.lesson: Use the SLSQP method with equality constraints to enforce the integral constraint in the optimization problem.

lessons.title: Ensure normalization and clipping
lessons.summary: Clipping and normalization prevent numerical instability and ensure the solution stays within bounds.
lessons.lesson: Clip the solution to [0, 1] and normalize it to maintain the integral constraint.

lessons.title: Try random initialization on failure
lessons.summary: Random initialization helps escape local minima and improve the optimization result.
lessons.lesson: If the optimization fails to converge, try a random initialization and re-run the optimization.

lessons.title: Track and return the best solution
lessons.summary: Track the best solution found during optimization to ensure the best possible result is returned.
lessons.lesson: During the optimization process, keep track of the best solution found so far and return it as the final result.
